title: Final speed of A
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state or calculate the speed of object A just before impact as 2 m/s.

title: Final time for B
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state or calculate the time for B to return to the bottom as 1 s.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important Criteria: The solution should correctly apply the work-energy theorem or conservation of energy to find the common speed of A and B before A hits the ground.

title: B's post-break acceleration
description: Important Criteria: The solution must identify that after the string breaks, B moves under gravity on the incline with acceleration g sin θ (6 m/s²).

title: B's post-break kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly set up kinematic equations for B's upward and downward motion after the break, using its initial velocity and acceleration.

title: Energy for B's final speed
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may use energy conservation to find B's speed when it returns to the bottom, confirming the kinematic result.

title: Sign error in velocity
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the sign or direction of B's initial velocity after A hits the ground.

title: Ignoring B's initial motion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student assumes B starts from rest on the incline after the break, neglecting its existing upward velocity.
